asks: Why can Silo give a complete account of what happened?
answer: Only agents work there. On your own laptop, a recording of everything would be mostly you, and nobody wants that. In a computer, nearly every process, file change and connection is agent work, so recording all of it is worth doing. You visit, and what you do there is told apart; how is to find out. The account covers the whole computer, and where Silo could not see, it says so.
